notes.title: Update notes for 28AUG2024
notes.notes:
New features and regions in this update
- Sails the wide, wide, sea
- Climb Winterspire Peak
- Enter the Tombs of Time
- New quest system
- Credits

notes.title: Update notes for Apr 30
notes.notes:
- All keepsakes now have 2d icons
- Add dedicated control for sprint
- RIght stick / mouse move now pans the camera
- User interface controls can be remapped
- UI updates
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Update for April 23 #2
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where treasure chests won't save their open state

notes.title: Update notes for April 23
notes.notes:
Hey alphas,

This update adds additional sidequests (like speed boots and keepsakes) and new features (like multiple save slots). It will reset your progress though and I apologize for that...

notes.title: Update notes for April 10
notes.notes: Hey alpha testers, version 0.2.12 is live and available to play. This release has the Cave of the Lost, the wall breaker ability, and you can enter the Oracle's Castle. It also have improved UI and equip system but you'll notice some parts of menu system have not been updated (yet!). Looking forward to hearing your feedback. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: update notes for Mar 19
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that in the crates puzzle

notes.title: Update notes for Feb 19
notes.notes:
Hey alphas, 

Here are the updates in this release (0.2.2):

-separate buttons for interact and jump
-weapon can now be swung at anytime if equipped
-added moving plaforms to cave
-added eletric switches to cave for improved puzzle gameplay
-improved performance & fixed grass issues on Med / Low
-reduced dialogue
-reduced camera movement
-new enemy owl music
-death animation changed to dazed animation
-updated night time ambient track

notes.title: Update for Feb 2 #2
notes.notes: Hey everyone. This release (0.1.20) has fixes for the world loading / unloading introduced in the last release. Sorry about that!

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 2
notes.notes:
Hey Night Stones, this release (0.1.19) has the following changes:

 Full key rebinding for controllers and keyboards
 Crates can be carried longer
 Fixed bug where changing quality settings changes players run speed

notes.title: Update notes for January 24
notes.notes:
Heyya Night Stone Alphas! This release includes the following:

 You can fly with the glider!
 More of Oracle's Cave is available
 More story and more characters
 Crate carrying has been implemented
 Graphics menu implemented
 Alot of bug fixes
